# Object field reference-runtime differential (probe Temp/opencode/objfieldprobe, .NET SDK 10.0.401)
# Reference: SerializableTreeType.FromRootNode plus SerializableStructure.Read over C#-constructed gen12 files (ITypeResolver.Null).
# F1 (VALUES): int, float, self-aligning string, nested struct, int vector (no flag, 4-aligned), byte vector with AlignBytes (0x4000) plus pad. F2 (ARRAYS): string vector, nested int vector vector, empty vector.
# Source facts: string nodes carry an Array child (leaf strings resolve Complex); strings self-align; arrays align only with AlignBytes (Rust aligns 2019.4 arrays by version rule; both agree on these realistic files).
# Format: OBJ_HEX|case|hex(file); OBJ_READ|case|dump
OBJ_HEX|F1|
OBJ_READ|F1|F1|INT=305419896|FLT=1.5|STR=hi|NEST=-5,2.5|INTS=10,20,30|BYTES=1,2,3,4,5
OBJ_HEX|F2|
OBJ_READ|F2|F2|STRS=a,bb,ccc|MAT=1,2;3|EMPTY=0
